answer: Random mutual audit blocks fake identities. Each epoch, a beacon pairs every agent with three random peers who inspect its work, like climbers checking ropes before a summit attempt. The audit trail flows like a river into a log, so no fake can hide in a lagoon of silence: failing two audits forfeits a 20-unit deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 100x20=2000 units, all sunk. An honest agent pays once, passes, and keeps its reward undiluted.
